verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI documents MCP client support: MCP servers can be configured in ~/.gemini/settings.json to add custom tools, and the CLI provides a /mcp command. The README also shows a GitHub MCP example ("@github List my open pull requests"), so connecting workflow tools is plausible through third-party or custom MCP servers. However, nothing in the evidence names Jira, Slack, or Google Drive integrations. Missing for 10: documented Jira/Slack/Google Drive connectors or examples, first-party workflow-tool integrations, independent hands-on corroboration of such connections.
